messages:
Priya Nair: All-hands was peak energy. Quick non-work check-in: who wants biscuits in the demo room in 10? :raised_hand:
Carlos Mendes: me me me. will bring jam. :bread:
Zoe Lin: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-confetti-1g3A7Cq3XK0s0 - that CEO mic drop deserved confetti. :confetti_ball:
DeployBot: Poll created: "Snack sprint" — 1: Biscuits, 2: Savory crackers, 3: Fruit, 4: Nothing (I ate it already). Vote with emoji 1-4.
Marta Ruiz: biscuits + coffee please. also can we add a tiny gong for the rollout cheer? low-cost morale boost. :gong:
Ethan Park: I volunteer to be gongkeeper. will practice dramatic slow-roll.
Raj Singh: can someone clip the bit where the CEO said "we're optimizing for feelings not just p99s"? that's my new mantra. :laughing:
Priya Nair: @Raj Singh that line is going on my laptop sticker ideas.
Carlos Mendes: Poll results: Biscuits 57%, Savory crackers 22%, Fruit 15%, Nothing 6%. Biscuits win! :tada:
Zoe Lin: also, shoutout to infra for the rollback flip — chef's kiss. :ok_hand:
Marta Ruiz: small ask: can we get a quiet room sign when there's a recording? my doorbell ringtone is too opera. :sweat_smile:
Ethan Park: noted. UX will run a quick poll on ringtone etiquette.
Priya Nair: who wants to lead a 15-min office-plant-care session next Friday? zero pressure, bring succulents or memes.
Raj Singh: i'll teach a 3-step watering ritual. step 1: feel the soil, step 2: whisper encouragements, step 3: hope for the best. :seedling:
Zoe Lin: RSVP for biscuits + plant class in #random. Also tagging @Librarian for sticker printing approvals.
DeployBot: Reminder: all-hands recording uploaded: https://redwood.co/recordings/3412345678
Marta Ruiz: thanks team. biscuit caravan at 2:45pm, ukulele cameo optional but highly encouraged. :ukulele:
